queue.title: Imirongo y'abakozi
queue.mixed_queue_title: Uru rutonde rufite ibintu bibiri bitandukanye
queue.mixed_queue_body: Ibifashwe kubera inyandiko bifite ibimenyetso by'isuzuma. Ibifashwe kubera icyemezo cya nyuma ntabyo bifite: nta nyandiko yo kureba.
queue.document_hint: Inyandiko igikoresho kitashoboye kwemeza. Ikimenyetso cy'isesengura ni ukwibutsa kureba, ntabwo ari icyemezo.
queue.adjudication_hint: Ubusabe bwafashwe nyuma y'icyemezo cyo kwirukana cyatinze. Nta kimenyetso cy'inyandiko bufite.
queue.truncated: Hagaragara {{shown}} za mbere muri {{total}}. Gabanya urutonde muri Ubusabe urebe ibisigaye.
queue.registry_hint: Ibi bitegereje isuzuma rya rejisitiri. Nta cyemezo gishobora kwandikwa hano ubu: inyandiko itegereje ko isuzuma ry'icyaha cyangwa iry'amashuri rikemurwa. Fungura ubusabe urebe ibyageze.

confirm.rejectBody: Hazandikwa kwangwa. Komeza gusa niba impamvu zasuzumwe.
confirm.acceptBody: Kwemerwa ni ihame kandi bishobora gukuraho ubundi busabe bw'umukandida bukiri mu nzira.

bulk.shortlistAll: Shyira ku rutonde abategereje icyemezo bose
bulk.confirmBody: Icyemezo kizakoreshwa kuri dosiye {{count}} zitegereje icyemezo cya nyuma.
bulk.oneByOne: Dosiye zifatirwa icyemezo imwe imwe; buri imwe ifite igisubizo cyayo kandi kwangwa kwa imwe ntibihagarika izindi.
